SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tracks
FROM track;

SELECT name
FROM genre;

SELECT MAX(unit_price) AS highest_price
FROM track;

SELECT
    first_name,
    last_name,
    company
FROM
    customer
WHERE
    company IS NOT NULL
    AND company <> '';

SELECT
    g.name AS genre_name,
    COUNT(t.track_id) AS track_count
FROM genre AS g
LEFT JOIN track AS t
    ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id
GROUP BY g.name
ORDER BY g.name;

SELECT
    ar.name AS artist_name,
    COUNT(al.album_id) AS album_count
FROM artist AS ar
JOIN album AS al ON al.artist_id = ar.artist_id
GROUP BY ar.name
ORDER BY album_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT billing_country,
       SUM(total) AS total_sales
FROM   invoice
GROUP BY billing_country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name
FROM customer AS c
JOIN employee AS e ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id
WHERE e.first_name = 'Jane' AND e.last_name = 'Peacock';

SELECT
    mt.name AS media_type,
    AVG(t.milliseconds) / 60000.0 AS average_length_minutes
FROM track t
JOIN media_type mt ON t.media_type_id = mt.media_type_id
GROUP BY mt.name
ORDER BY mt.name;

SELECT a.title,
       COUNT(t.track_id) AS track_count
FROM album a
JOIN track t ON t.album_id = a.album_id
GROUP BY a.album_id, a.title
HAVING COUNT(t.track_id) > 20
ORDER BY track_count DESC;

SELECT g.name
FROM genre g
JOIN track t ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id
GROUP BY g.genre_id, g.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS track_count
FROM playlist_track pt
JOIN playlist p ON pt.playlist_id = p.playlist_id
WHERE p.name = '90’s Music';

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)::int AS year,
    SUM(total) AS revenue
FROM invoice
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

SELECT
    g.name AS genre,
    SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS revenue
FROM invoice_line AS il
JOIN track AS t        ON il.track_id = t.track_id
JOIN genre AS g        ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id
GROUP BY g.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    e.first_name,
    e.last_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(i.total), 0) AS total
FROM employee e
LEFT JOIN customer c
    ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id
LEFT JOIN invoice i
    ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
ORDER BY total DESC;

WITH cust_spend AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.country,
        c.first_name,
        c.last_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(i.total), 0) AS total_spend
    FROM customer c
    LEFT JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.country, c.first_name, c.last_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY total_spend DESC) AS rnk
    FROM cust_spend
)
SELECT
    country,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    total_spend
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY country, last_name, first_name;

WITH monthly_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date) AS month_start,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM invoice_date)::INT AS month,
        SUM(total) AS revenue
    FROM invoice
    WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND invoice_date <  DATE '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY month_start, month
),
all_months AS (
    SELECT generate_series(DATE '2024-01-01', DATE '2024-12-01', INTERVAL '1 month') AS month_start
)
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM a.month_start)::INT AS month,
    COALESCE(m.revenue, 0) AS revenue,
    LAG(COALESCE(m.revenue, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY a.month_start) AS previous_month_revenue
FROM all_months a
LEFT JOIN monthly_rev m
       ON a.month_start = m.month_start
ORDER BY month;

SELECT
    a.name AS artist_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.genre_id) AS genre_count
FROM artist a
JOIN album al      ON al.artist_id = a.artist_id
JOIN track t       ON t.album_id = al.album_id
WHERE t.genre_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.artist_id, a.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.genre_id) > 3
ORDER BY genre_count DESC, artist_name;

SELECT
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    ct.total_spend
FROM
    customer c
JOIN (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(total) AS total_spend
    FROM
        invoice
    GROUP BY
        customer_id
) ct ON c.customer_id = ct.customer_id
WHERE
    ct.total_spend > (
        SELECT
            AVG(sub.total_spend)
        FROM (
            SELECT
                SUM(total) AS total_spend
            FROM
                invoice
            GROUP BY
                customer_id
        ) sub
    );

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.first_name,

        SUM(i.total) AS total_spent
    FROM customer c
    JOIN invoice i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
),
avg_spend AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_spent) AS avg_total FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT
    cs.first_name,
    cs.last_name,
    cs.total_spent
FROM customer_spend cs
CROSS JOIN avg_spend a
WHERE cs.total_spent > a.avg_total
ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC;

WITH customer_spend AS (

) ranked

SELECT ROUND(
         (video_rev / NULLIF(total_rev, 0)) * 100,
         2
       ) AS video_sales_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS total_rev
    FROM invoice_line il
) AS t
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS video_rev
    FROM invoice_line il
    JOIN track tr          ON il.track_id = tr.track_id
    JOIN media_type mt     ON tr.media_type_id = mt.media_type_id
    WHERE mt.name ILIKE '%video%'
) AS v;

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.first_name AS cust_first_name,
        c.last_name  AS cust_last_name,
        c.support_rep_id,
        SUM(i.total) AS spend
    FROM customer c
    JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY
        c.customer_id,
        c.first_name,
        c.last_name,
        c.support_rep_id
),
rep_max AS (
    SELECT
        support_rep_id,
        MAX(spend) AS max_spend
    FROM customer_spend
    GROUP BY support_rep_id
)
SELECT
    e.first_name AS rep_first_name,
    e.last_name  AS rep_last_name,
    cs.cust_first_name,
    cs.cust_last_name,
    cs.spend
FROM customer_spend cs
JOIN rep_max rm
      ON cs.support_rep_id = rm.support_rep_id
     AND cs.spend = rm.max_spend
JOIN employee e
      ON e.employee_id = cs.support_rep_id
ORDER BY e.employee_id, cs.cust_last_name, cs.cust_first_name;

ORDER BY birth_date;

WITH total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS total_amount
    FROM invoice_line il
),
video_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS video_amount
    FROM invoice_line il
    JOIN track t          ON il.track_id = t.track_id
    JOIN media_type mt   ON t.media_type_id = mt.media_type_id
    WHERE mt.name ILIKE '%video%'
)
SELECT ROUND((video_sales.video_amount / total_sales.total_amount) * 100, 2) AS video_sales_percentage
FROM total_sales, video_sales;

SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM invoice_date)::int AS day_of_week,
       COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
FROM invoice
WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND invoice_date <  DATE '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY day_of_week
ORDER BY day_of_week;

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.first_name AS cust_first_name,
        c.last_name  AS cust_last_name,
        c.support_rep_id,
        SUM(i.total) AS spend
    FROM customer c
    JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY
        c.customer_id,
        c.first_name,
        c.last_name,
        c.support_rep_id
)
SELECT
    e.first_name AS rep_first_name,
    e.last_name  AS rep_last_name,
    cs.cust_first_name,
    cs.cust_last_name,
    cs.spend
FROM (
    SELECT
        cs.*,
        MAX(cs.spend) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.support_rep_id) AS max_spend
    FROM customer_spend cs
) cs
JOIN employee e
    ON e.employee_id = cs.support_rep_id
WHERE cs.spend = cs.max_spend
ORDER BY e.employee_id, cs.cust_last_name, cs.cust_first_name;

SELECT a.name
FROM artist a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM track t
    JOIN album al ON t.album_id = al.album_id
    JOIN invoice_line il ON il.track_id = t.track_id
    WHERE al.artist_id = a.artist_id
)
ORDER BY a.name;

SELECT
    quarter,
    revenue,
    LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY quarter) AS previous_quarter_revenue
FROM (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM invoice_date)::INT AS quarter,
        SUM(total) AS revenue
    FROM invoice
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2024
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM invoice_date)
) AS q
ORDER BY quarter;

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(week FROM invoice_date)::int AS week_number,
    SUM(total) AS revenue
FROM invoice
WHERE EXTRACT(isoyear FROM invoice_date) = 2023
GROUP BY week_number
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_media_type_count
FROM media_type;

SELECT
    mt.name AS media_type_name,
    AVG(t.bytes) AS average_bytes
FROM
    track t
JOIN
    media_type mt ON t.media_type_id = mt.media_type_id
GROUP BY
    mt.name
ORDER BY
    mt.name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS playlist_count
FROM (
    SELECT pt.playlist_id
    FROM playlist_track pt
    JOIN track t ON pt.track_id = t.track_id
    WHERE t.genre_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY pt.playlist_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.genre_id) >= 10
) AS sub;

SELECT first_name, last_name, birth_date
FROM employee
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM birth_date) BETWEEN 1970 AND 1979
ORDER BY birth_date;

SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 *
         SUM(CASE WHEN mt.name ILIKE '%video%' THEN il.unit_price * il.quantity ELSE 0 END) /
         SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity),
         2
       ) AS video_sales_percentage
FROM invoice_line AS il
JOIN track AS t          ON il.track_id = t.track_id
JOIN media_type AS mt    ON t.media_type_id = mt.media_type_id;

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(DOW FROM invoice_date)::int AS day_of_week,
    COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
FROM invoice
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2024
GROUP BY day_of_week
ORDER BY day_of_week;
